m.meaning: posterior mean of the generative state

withheld.inference_gru_c64: the inference GRU hidden state is never handed to a consumer
withheld.within_minute_event_memory: the per-event GRU state is internal to the encoder
withheld.reason: the single export contract keeps every consumer reading the same object

H1.reads: posterior samples of the same Q, advanced by f and read out by g
H1.note: P is part of the predictive uncertainty, not a separate score

H2a_A.reads: m only, 24 dimensions, standardised inside the consumer FIT

H2a_B.reads: m only, alongside the genuinely observed event prefix

S_A.reads: the fixed functional coordinates of the frozen g applied to the same Q

S_B.reads: the same m and C as H2a-A, through the frozen interictal contact head

common_C.reads: the legal clock, measurement support and deterministic recording timers
common_C.availability: offered identically to every arm and every consumer

representation_classes.static_trait: FIT contact dictionary, geometry and templates; never refitted on the scored period
representation_classes.unlearned_input_driven: a checkpoint selected at step 0 still varies with history through the fixed recurrent map; this is not a static trait
representation_classes.learned: parameters that moved away from initialisation, evidenced by the parameter inventory

identity.same_state_means: one producer, one export function and its fixed projections
identity.does_not_mean: that consumer input tensors are identical or that Q is a sufficient statistic
